question: Is the seed clear enough to start design? Issue 746: spacedock pi double-loads the pi-subagents extension when the package is also registered, failing with 'Tool subagent conflicts'. Proposed fix: gate the explicit --extension/--skill flags on the package NOT being already registered (preserving the dev-override purpose). Stacked on PR 725 (rebased). Ready to enter ideation?

artifacts.summary: Seed for issue #746: spacedock pi loads pi-subagents twice (package discovery + unconditional explicit --extension/--skill in internal/cli/pi.go) when the package is also in settings.json packages, colliding on 'Tool subagent conflicts'. Direction: gate the explicit flags on the package not being registered (flags exist for the dev-override case per code comments). AC sketch: registered -> one load, no conflict; dev-override -> explicit flags. Expected surface: internal/cli/pi.go + test, small diff. Stacked on rebased PR 725.
